span.p:
tx_fifo
8 bits × depth
tx_push → append
pull_en → drop head

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center;

span.p:
shift_dir reg, 1 bit
rst → 0 (LSB first)
cfg_en & field 0 → own[0]

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center;

span.p:
shift_reg reg, 8 bits
rst → 0
pull_en → fifo_head
shift_en → shift toward the wire end
shift_bit = shift_dir ? [7] : [0]

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center;

span.p:
open_drain reg, 4 bits
rst → 0 (push-pull)
cfg_en & field 1 → [1:0] ← own[1:0]
cfg_en & field 2 → [3:2] ← own[1:0]

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center;

span.p:
gpio reg, 4 bits
rst → 4'b1111
shift_en → gpio[0] ← shift_bit
gpio_en → gpio[side_pin] ← side_val
acc_en & ACC_OUT → gpio[acc_pin] ← acc[15]
gpio_oe = ~(open_drain & gpio)
